# Ella's discovery + negotiation role play
Date: 2026-10-14 | Duration: 66m

## Summary
Preparation focused on reviewing BDR and SE information, prospect priorities, and research from LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Sumble, and AI tools. Roblox needs one standardized experimentation and feature-flagging platform because engineers move between two or three homegrown systems and BI tools; it currently runs 30–40 experiments but seeks 10x more. The evaluation would involve about 100 developers and product staff, shortlist two or three vendors, and conduct a 90-day POV, with usability, production performance, and adoption as key criteria. A follow-up was scheduled for October 22 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific with Christian Liebenau. In the fictional negotiation, the offer reached $80,000 for a two-year contract paid annually, including onboarding and a case study. Feedback praised Ella Candage’s confidence, follow-up, negotiation instincts, and hiring potential, while recommending earlier impact quantification, less repetition, stronger credibility positioning, and value-based concessions. References and further compensation, hours, and equity discussions remained outstanding.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Experimentation platforms, Feature flagging, Sales discovery, Pricing negotiation, Hiring evaluation
